name: Omaha Poker: PLO Offline Game
description:
Play Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO) offline against smart AI opponents. Four hole cards, real poker decisions, Sit & Go tournaments. Free, no wifi needed, and no real money.

Omaha poker deals you four hole cards instead of two, and you must use exactly two of them with three from the board. That single rule makes PLO faster and richer than Texas Holdem: more draws, bigger pots and a genuine read on every street. If you know Holdem, Omaha is your next step.

SMART OPPONENTS, NOT BUTTONS
• The bots read their own cards — they play tight or loose, value-bet, bluff, and know when to fold
• Choose Easy, Medium or Hard, or sit at the high-stakes tables where the bots play their best
• Practise offline poker whenever you like — no waiting for other players, no lobby queues

SIT & GO TOURNAMENTS
• Bronze, Silver and Gold Sit and Go events with rising blind levels
• Top three finishers are paid, 50/30/20 — play for the win, not just to survive

EVERY OMAHA FORMAT
• Pot-Limit Omaha (PLO), Omaha Hi-Lo (Omaha 8 or better) and 5-Card Omaha tables
• Cash games from 5/10 up to 100/200, all in free play-money points
• Pot-size bet shortcuts: 1/2 pot, 3/4 pot, pot and all-in

A POKER TRAINER IN YOUR POCKET
• Live hand insight: your win chance, the pot odds on a call, and your outs grouped by what they make
• A pre-flop starting-hand grade, so you learn which four-card hands are worth playing
• In-app Help & Rules covering Omaha hand rankings and the two-cards-from-your-hand rule
• Full hand history — replay any pot street by street
• Poker stats that matter: hands played, win rate, VPIP, biggest pot, best hand

PROGRESS AND REWARDS
• Earn XP, climb player levels and collect a chip reward each time you level up
• 12 achievements to unlock and fresh daily missions on your Wallet
• Add friends by name and compare points on your own leaderboard, kept on this device

PLAYS OFFLINE
• Every hand is dealt on your device — no internet connection needed to play
• Play Omaha poker offline on a plane, on the subway, anywhere — no wifi
• No account, no sign-up, no login of any kind — install and play
• Your points, stats, hand history and friends list stay on this device
• No ads and no in-app purchases
• Available in 19 languages, including Arabic and Hebrew

Install Omaha Poker and deal your first pot limit omaha hand in seconds.

Looking for an omaha poker game, a plo poker trainer, or simply poker offline with no wifi? This four card poker app covers omaha holdem, omaha hi lo with 8-or-better split pots, and five card omaha, with offline AI practice in every format.

NO REAL MONEY, EVER
This game is for entertainment. All chips and points are virtual, have no cash value, and cannot be cashed out, purchased, or exchanged for anything of value. There is no real-money gambling of any kind. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real-money gambling.
